title: Audited re-bind of a person's organization identity, and the audit log on disk
spec: audit_file: the data directory's audit.log holds the server-core audit hash chain (T125), one line per entry (seq TAB at_ms TAB prev hex TAB hash hex TAB actor TAB action), appended with O_APPEND, owner-only, synced; read checks the chain and refuses an edited, removed or reordered entry; append refuses fields that are empty, longer than MAX_FIELD or have control characters, refuses to build on a broken log, and never goes back in time. `crewcraft-server rebind <data> <email> --issuer <issuer> --subject <subject>` (offline) re-binds an enrolled person (no one enrolled under that address, or an identity bound to someone else, is refused and records nothing), then appends 'identity.rebind <email> to <issuer> <subject> was <old or none>' by 'operator <OS user>'; a failed append after the binding is an error saying so. `crewcraft-server audit <data>` prints every entry and the head hash, and exits non-zero when the chain does not check out.
